header.title: How to Replace a Dishwasher Heating Element
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to safely replace a faulty heating element in a dishwasher. Follow these instructions to restore your dishwasher's heating function.

steps.description: This step instructs you to find the heating element in the dishwasher tub, potentially removing a cover to access it.
actions: Locate the heating element in the tub of the dishwasher beneath the lower dish rack.
Recognize the heating element by its thin circular shape.
If a cover is present beneath the lower dish rack, remove it.
Use a screwdriver to remove the cover.

steps.description: This step involves accessing the dishwasher's wiring by removing the kick plate and marking the wires before disconnection.
actions: Locate the heating element.
Remove the kick plate.
Remove the retaining screws.
Look for the area where wires are connected to the terminals.
Mark the wires with sticky labels.

steps.description: Remove wires from terminals using needle-nose pliers to avoid damaging the wires or connectors.
actions: Grasp the slip-on connectors with needle-nose pliers
Remove the wires from each terminal

steps.description: Disconnect the wires from the heating element by removing the lock nuts securing the eyelet wire connectors.
actions: Remove lock nuts
Remove wires from heating element's terminal

steps.description: After disconnecting the wires, carefully remove the heating element from the dishwasher.
actions: Remove heating element wires from terminals
Lift heating element out of the dishwasher
Dispose of the heating element properly

steps.description: Secure the new heating element into its position and attach the wires using lock nuts.
actions: Put the wires through their appropriate openings in the dishwasher
Secure the heating element into its position
Attach the wires to the heating element using the lock nuts
Tighten the lock nuts into place

steps.description: This step involves securing the kick plate, placing a cover over the heating element, and testing the dishwasher.
actions: Secure the kick plate onto the dishwasher
Open the door of your dishwasher
Place the cover over the heating element
Place the lower dishwasher rack back in position
Restore the power to your unit
Conduct a test run
